responsibility: Implements rendering of diagnostic_path execution traces for human-readable outputs. This file contains the logic for grouping and consolidating path events, building range_label objects and label-effect edge information for linked source annotations, and printing paths both as text summaries/source-locus overlays and as HTML path markup via print_path_as_html. It is the presentation backend that consumes diagnostic_event and diagnostic_path data and turns it into user-visible control-flow and interprocedural path displays distinct from the core path data-model definitions.
